{{Top|leg}}
'''Docking Facility 7K''' was a facility at the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Ral Shawgrim]] performed an unauthorized [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] launch from Docking Facility 7K while attempting to defect to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after copying technical data on the [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wing starfighter]].
